listing.name: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role Recomp
listing.summary: Register a completed Know Your Role Windows player for your own SLUS-01234 disc, retaining its waiting Play entry and external saves.

steps.title: Complete the title’s supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Extract the upstream Windows package to a writable non-synced folder, keep every file, and complete KnowYourRole.exe setup using your own NTSC-U SLUS-01234 CUE/BIN. No BIOS is needed. Keep the disc where it is: the game still reads it. The upstream x64 Visual C++ runtime dependency is separate; Portcove does not install it or run disc preparation.

steps.title: Use the matching original and setup procedure
steps.instruction: Upstream verifies internal original files: SLUS_012.34 SHA-256 e23acb3165ed001b6d23558ef81624cea70b97d98e68a2a93546e6466a3c2a7f and EXE.PAC SHA-256 83cbdc663f1230b6c6b191e5572db1a9ef22520f65d2c7641c52d6632bae73a6. These member checks and the whole-track size warning are not a Portcove cryptographic certificate for every original input or generated output. Keep private Recompiled.* libraries private.

steps.title: Add the completed supported game program
steps.instruction: After upstream setup reports Ready, select the package-root KnowYourRole.exe with that root as working directory and --play as the literal argument. This supported entry checks readiness, sets the runtime working directory and data/log environment, waits for the actual game process and returns its exit code. Do not substitute a generator, diagnostics helper or a private runner merely because it is executable.

steps.title: Review launch details and manage updates
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage setup, game replacement and recovery. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and every data location it uses. Review and select the changed executable before playing again. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, conversion, data migration or deletion for these external files.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Keep the complete working game, originals, saves, settings, mods, caches, backups and every custom data location before changing versions. Another executable may use those same locations. These instructions do not establish Portcove-managed installation, gameplay or save compatibility.

references.title: Preserve the whole creating copy and effective data
references.instruction: Keep the entire package and KnowYourRole-files/runtime, including generated Recompiled.* libraries, build stamp and matching runtime. Back up KnowYourRole-files/user, including carda.sav, cardb.sav, settings.json, interface.ini, launcher.json, user controller mappings and logs. Existing RECOMPONE_DATA_DIR and RECOMPONE_LOG_DIR overrides take precedence: preserve their actual locations as well as mods, caches, backups and original disc. Retain MIT and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES; framework notices do not grant original-game rights.
